ticket.title: Split storypole-core index/mod.rs: 284 lines, over the hard 250 ceiling
ticket.description: storypole CI runs the same 250-line audit as every repo, so this file makes the audit step red today. miter slice proposes two extractions, neither with circular risk: (1) lines 33-204 to index/open_and_sync_index.rs carrying open_and_sync_index, apply_connection_pragmas, init_schema, check_needs_rebuild, rebuild_index, re-exported pub(crate), leaving ~116 lines; (2) lines 206-284 to index/insert_task_record.rs carrying insert_task_record. Do (1) first and re-run the audit, because (2) alone still leaves 205.
acceptance_criteria: Every .rs file under crates/ src/ tests/ is at or under 250 lines and the CI audit step passes
Extraction follows the miter slice blueprint and keeps pub(crate) visibility unchanged

verification_receipt.summary: index/mod.rs 284 lines became mod.rs 11 + schema 85 + rebuild 122 + insert_task_record 86; fmt/clippy/nextest green (44 tests); public paths re-exported unchanged
